title: Filing taxes for 2026
subject: Money

text: Filing taxes for 2026
This book is the federal return for tax year 2026.
You file that return in 2027. The year printed on Form 1040 is 2026.
The dollar amounts in this book are the 2026 amounts.
Lesson menu
Pick a part, or go in order.
What you will be able to do
Say which year this return covers.
Decide whether you have to file.
Find the standard deduction for your filing status.
File a normal return without buying TurboTax.
A normal return
Wages, maybe some bank interest, the standard deduction, and no rental property.
That is the return this book is for.
A business with employees, a farm, or a pile of rentals is a different return.
Two different years
The 2026 filing season was when people filed their 2025 returns.
This book is the next one: tax year 2026, filed in 2027.
The year in the corner of the form is the year you use.
Where the 2026 amounts are published
The IRS printed them in news release IR-2025-103, on October 9, 2025.
The long table is Revenue Procedure 2025-32.
The form you actually fill in is the 2026 Form 1040 and its instructions.
Check
Which return is this book about?

choices.label: Tax year 2026, which you file in 2027.
The 2025 return you filed during the 2026 filing season.
Any year, because the form never says.

text: Read the year on the form
Form 1040 has the year in the top corner.
A 2026 Form 1040 says 2026.
That is the return this book walks.
The instructions match the form
Use the instructions that say 2026 on the cover.
A 2025 instruction booklet answers a different return.
The news release is the list
IR-2025-103 is the IRS list of the 2026 inflation adjustments.
It says those amounts generally apply to returns filed in 2027.
The revenue procedure is the table
Revenue Procedure 2025-32 is the full table behind that news release.
When a page in this book names a dollar amount, that procedure is where the IRS listed it.
Draft is not the form you file
The IRS posted a draft 2026 Form 1040 in September 2026.
A draft is marked not for filing.
You file the final form, the one without that mark.
Check
You have a Form 1040 that says 2025 in the corner. What is it?

choices.label: The prior return. This book is the form that says 2026.
The same return, because the corner does not matter.
A draft of the 2026 return.

text: The usual test
Most people file if their gross income is at least the standard deduction for their filing status.
For 2026 that deduction is the filing threshold for people under 65.
Single, under 65
Standard deduction for 2026: $16,100.
Wages of $16,100 or more: file.
The source is IR-2025-103.
Married filing jointly, under 65
Standard deduction for 2026: $32,200.
That is the threshold when both of you are under 65.
Head of household, under 65
Standard deduction for 2026: $24,150.
Head of household is a real status. It is not a guess about who pays the rent.
Married filing separately
The 2026 Form 1040 instructions still use a $5 gross-income test for married filing separately.
Five dollars of gross income and you file.
Self-employment
Net earnings from self-employment of $400 or more: file.
That is true even when wages are under the standard deduction.
The test is in the Form 1040 instructions, under who must file.
You want money back
Tax was withheld and you want it refunded: file, even if you are under the threshold.
Check
You are single, under 65, and your only income is $14,000 of wages. Must you file the 2026 return?

choices.label: No. $14,000 is under the $16,100 standard deduction.
Yes. Everyone with a job must file.
Yes. The single threshold is $5.

text: Status is set on December 31
Your filing status is whatever was true on December 31, 2026.
Single, married filing jointly, married filing separately, head of household, or qualifying surviving spouse.
Married filing jointly
You were married on December 31 and you both sign one return.
The 2026 standard deduction on that return is $32,200 if you are both under 65.
Head of household is a test
Unmarried, you paid more than half the cost of keeping up the home, and a qualifying person lived with you.
The instructions define the qualifying person. The title is not enough.
Pick one
The form has one set of boxes.
You check one.
The instructions for that line are the 2026 Form 1040 instructions.
Check
You got married on December 15, 2026. What status can you use?

choices.label: Married. Status looks at December 31.
Single, because you were single for most of the year.
Head of household, because a wedding is a household.

text: The 2026 amounts
Single, or married filing separately: $16,100.
Married filing jointly, or a surviving spouse: $32,200.
Head of household: $24,150.
Those three numbers
They are in IR-2025-103.
They are also the first lines of the standard-deduction discussion in the 2026 instructions.
Age or blindness
If you are 65 or older, or blind, the instructions add another amount on top.
The 2026 Form 1040-ES prints that add-on: $2,050 if you are unmarried, $1,650 for each spouse who qualifies.
You take one or the other
Standard deduction or itemized deductions on Schedule A.
You use whichever is larger.
A normal wage return uses the standard deduction.
Check
Married filing jointly, both under 65, no blindness. What is the 2026 standard deduction?
Wages
The Form W-2 from each job goes on the wages line of Form 1040.
The box for federal income tax withheld is what you already paid in.
Bank interest
A Form 1099-INT is the bank telling you, and the IRS, what it paid.
It has its own line. The instructions name the line.
Self-employment income
You report it even when you also have a W-2.
Net profit of $400 or more is also the filing test from the earlier part.
What this book does not itemize
Rentals, a farm, a partnership, and stock options are real.
They are not the normal return.
The instructions for those have their own schedules.
Check
Your employer withheld federal tax and sent you a W-2. Where do the wages go?

choices.label: On the wages line of the 2026 Form 1040.
Nowhere, if you use software.
On Schedule A.

text: The extra $6,000
For 2025 through 2028, a person who is 65 or older can claim an additional $6,000 deduction.
Two spouses who both qualify: $12,000.
The IRS states that on its Working Families Tax Cuts page.
It sits on top
That $6,000 is in addition to the extra standard deduction for age.
The 2026 instructions say which line.
You do not have to memorize the line. You have to open that page.
Check
Both spouses are 66 in 2026 and both qualify. How much is the additional senior deduction, before the age add-on to the standard deduction?

choices.label: $6,000 for the couple.

text: Three places, in order
First the 2026 Form 1040, the line you are filling in.
Then the 2026 instructions for that line.
Then, for a figure that is set for the year, IR-2025-103 or Revenue Procedure 2025-32.
The form is the blank
The line names the thing: wages, standard deduction, refund.
The instructions tell you what goes there.
The news release is the index
IR-2025-103 is a few pages.
It points at the revenue procedure for the rest of the table.
Do not stop at a headline
A news site can tell you the deduction changed.
The number you put on the return is the one in the instructions for that form year.
Check
You want the official 2026 standard deduction. What do you open?

choices.label: IR-2025-103, or the 2026 Form 1040 instructions.
A 2025 instruction booklet.
Whatever a search ad puts first.

text: A normal person does not need TurboTax
TurboTax is a product.
It is not the return, and it is not a requirement.
A wage earner with the standard deduction can finish without it.
TaxSlayer is enough
For that normal return, TaxSlayer at taxslayer.com is enough.
It asks the questions, fills Form 1040, and e-files.
You do not get a better tax result by paying a bigger brand to type the same W-2.
The government already has free tools
IRS Free File is on IRS.gov.
You start at IRS.gov/freefile.
If you start on a company's own home page, you are not in the IRS free offer.
Who the free software covers
For the season that filed 2025 returns, guided Free File software was for adjusted gross income of $89,000 or less.
The dollar line for the season you are in is printed on that IRS Free File page.
Read the page for the season. Eight partners were listed for that 2026 season.
Fillable Forms
IRS Free File Fillable Forms are the forms on a screen.
They are free at any income.
You use them if you are comfortable following the instructions yourself.
A person, if you want one
VITA and TCE are IRS-certified volunteers.
MilTax is the Defense Department tool for the military community.
Those are also government free paths. They are listed in the IRS season announcement.
Direct File is not the plan
The IRS list of free options for the 2026 season names Free File, Fillable Forms, VITA, TCE, and MilTax.
It does not name Direct File.
You do not wait for Direct File.
Check
You have one W-2 and you will take the standard deduction. What do you need?

choices.label: TaxSlayer, or IRS Free File started from IRS.gov. Not TurboTax.
TurboTax, because the IRS requires it.
A look-alike site that says free on the ad.

text: The papers on the table
Form W-2 from each job.
Form 1099-INT if a bank paid you interest.
Last year's return, so the name and Social Security number match.
The status
December 31, 2026 decides it.
Check one box.
The deduction
Single, under 65: $16,100.
Married filing jointly, both under 65: $32,200.
Head of household, under 65: $24,150.
Then the software
Type the W-2 into TaxSlayer, or into a Free File partner you opened from IRS.gov.
The software is filling the 2026 Form 1040.
You can open the instruction for any line it asks about.
Check
The software asks for your wages. What do you type?

choices.label: The wages from each 2026 Form W-2.
The standard deduction.
Whatever you were paid in cash with no form.

text: One form per job
Each employer sends a Form W-2 for the year.
Two jobs, two W-2s. Both go on the return.
Box 1 is the wages
Box 1 of the W-2 is the wages you report.
That number, from every W-2, is the wages line.
Box 2 is what you already paid
Box 2 is federal income tax withheld.
That is a payment, not income.
It reduces what you still owe, or it comes back as a refund.
The name has to match
The name and Social Security number on the return match the Social Security card.
A nickname that is not on the card is how an e-file gets rejected.
You do not attach the W-2 to an e-file
You type box 1 and box 2.
You keep the W-2 with your copy of the return.
Check
Which box on the W-2 is the wages?

choices.label: Box 1.
Box 2. That is the wages.
Neither. The software invents the wages.

text: Withholding is a payment
Your employer sent box 2 to the IRS during the year.
The return adds those payments up.
Refund or balance
If the payments are more than the tax, the difference is the refund.
If the payments are less, you pay the difference when you file.
A bigger refund is not a bigger tax break
A refund is your own money coming back.
TaxSlayer does not find a different answer than another program typing the same W-2 and the same deduction.
You can file to get the refund
Under the filing threshold, and tax was withheld: file if you want the withholding back.
Check
Box 2 is larger than the tax on the return. What happens?

choices.label: You get a refund of the difference.
You owe that amount again.
The IRS keeps it because you used free software.

text: E-file
TaxSlayer, and the IRS Free File partners, transmit the return.
You are not mailing a paper Form 1040 unless you chose to.
Keep a copy
Save the PDF the software gives you.
Save the W-2s.
Next year's return starts from this one.
An extension is time to file
Form 4868 gives more time to file.
It does not give more time to pay.
If you will owe, the payment is still due on the filing date.
This book is the federal return
A state return is a separate form.
TaxSlayer will offer the state return.
Some Free File partners include a state return. The IRS partner page says which.
Check
You file Form 4868. What did you get?

choices.label: More time to file. Not more time to pay.
More time to pay, and you do not file at all.
A larger standard deduction.

text: Open TaxSlayer
Go to taxslayer.com.
Start a 2026 return.
You are not creating an account on TurboTax.
Name and Social Security number
Type them as they appear on the Social Security card.
Do this for each person on the return.
The status question
Answer with what was true on December 31, 2026.
One status.
The W-2 screen
Add a W-2.
Type box 1 and box 2.
Add another W-2 if you had another job.
Interest
If you have a 1099-INT, enter it when the software asks about interest.
No 1099-INT, and the bank paid you nothing: leave it.
The deduction screen
A normal return takes the standard deduction.
The software should show $16,100, $32,200, or $24,150, matching your status.
If it does not, stop and open the 2026 instructions.
Read the refund before you send
The refund, or the amount due, is on the form the software filled in.
You can look at the Form 1040 it produced.
Then you e-file.
Check
The deduction screen shows a number that is not in this book. What do you do?

choices.label: Open the 2026 Form 1040 instructions and use that amount.
Send it. The software is always newer.
Switch to TurboTax so the number changes.

text: No Schedule A
If the standard deduction is larger than your itemized deductions, you do not file Schedule A.
A renter with no big medical bills and no mortgage is in that group.
No schedule for a simple bank account
Interest from a 1099-INT goes on the interest line.
You do not need a business schedule for a savings account.
No paid upgrade
A screen that offers audit protection, a bigger refund, or a professional review is a sale.
The Form 1040 is finished without it.
State is the other return
Finish the federal return first.
The state return, if you need one, uses the federal numbers.
This book does not invent your state's rules.
Keep the confirmation
When the e-file is accepted, save the confirmation.
That is the proof you filed the 2026 return.
You are done when the form is filed
Not when you bought a program.
Not when you watched a video.
When the 2026 Form 1040 is accepted.
Check
The software offers a paid add-on after the Form 1040 is filled in. Do you need it?

choices.label: No. The return is the form, not the add-on.
Yes. The IRS rejects a return without it.
Yes, if you used TaxSlayer instead of TurboTax.

text: You can file this one
You know the form year is 2026 and that you file it in 2027.
You know the three standard deduction amounts.
You know a normal return does not require TurboTax.
The other book
The next lesson is how to find the current page when you are looking something up.
This book already used that method: form, instructions, IR-2025-103.
Check
Where are the 2026 standard deduction amounts published?

choices.label: IR-2025-103 and the 2026 Form 1040 instructions.
Only inside TurboTax.
They are not published until you file.

text: End of the lesson
File the 2026 Form 1040.
Use TaxSlayer, or start at IRS.gov/freefile.
The amounts in this book are the 2026 amounts.

notes: Tax year 2026, filed in 2027. Amounts from IRS IR-2025-103 and the 2026 Form 1040 instructions. A normal return can be done in TaxSlayer. Free File starts at IRS.gov/freefile. Not tax advice.
